ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white/yellow-white) pixel clusters at the distal tips; approximate distribution of 92% low-intensity to 8% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; a secondary area of diffuse grey-white mottling is visible at the basal region near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; interior angle approximately 40-45 degrees; apex is sharply defined and oriented toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; irregular peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes, most pronounced on the inner half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the superior margins, tapering to acute, slightly recurved tips at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated, high-contrast circular and irregular clusters at the lobe tips, exhibiting yellowish-white pixel values relative to the dark fluke body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal light-grey linear streaks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, intersecting the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting high-contrast scarring at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and droplets detaching from the trailing edge and median notch during the fluke-up maneuver.
